content: Fabric 26.2 supports vanilla Saved Data and Fabric Data Attachments with Codecs. Global attachments provide server-wide state, while entity, level, and chunk attachments can persist and optionally sync. Official guidance says attachment values should be immutable and mutated only through attachment API methods. For this mod, one persistent immutable campaign record attached globally or stored as Saved Data plus SynchedEntityData for boss presentation keeps authority and persistence simple.
